subject: MAP & legal sequencing: aligning MSA/DPA/order form milestones for AstraNova pilot
messages:
From: Lindsey Parker <lindsey.parker@astranova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the tech looked solid and the latency profile hit our baseline. Procurement asked me to get a concrete MAP in place that ties evaluation milestones to legal and procurement gating. I attached AstraNova's MAP template and a short list of DPA questions we need answered for our security/compliance board.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Procurement approval window: target signature 8/20/2026, but finance requires final order form by 8/6 for fiscal planning.
- Security team requires SOC 2 Type II evidence or equivalent attestation by 7/30; we can accept an existing third-party report + Redwood's data handling summary.
- Legal would like to see an MSA redline and an order-form stub by 6/25 to start internal review cycles.

Can Redwood provide a proposed sequencing (MAP) that:
1) maps evaluation milestones to delivery of MSA redline / DPA responses / order form stub,
2) calls out single points of contact for each milestone (legal, security, procurement), and
3) highlights any known blockers on your side for the dates above.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync early next week to align owners? Evan Cole (copied) will coordinate procurement availability.

Attachments: AstraNova_MAP_template.xlsx; DPA_questions_annotated.docx

Best,
Lindsey
Lindsey Parker
Head of Procurement, AstraNova Health
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Parker <lindsey.parker@astranova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form)

Lindsey — thanks for the clear constraints. I put together a lightweight MAP (attached) that reflects our recommended sequencing and owners. Key points up front:

- We can have an MSA redline ready for initial review by 6/25, but that assumes we don't need to negotiate non-standard indemnity or escrow terms; those items add 1–2 weeks.
- DPA responses (section-level notes + proposed edits) — deliverable by 6/22. Security artifacts (SOC 2 summary + data-flow) — deliverable by 7/02.
- Order form stub (pricing + billing contact) — we can share a draft by 6/28; finalization aligned to your 8/6 internal deadline.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Legal / MSA redline: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Security / DPA + artifacts: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)
- Commercial / order form & billing: Sean Gallagher (sean_gallagher@redwood.com)

I've called out two sequencing constraints in the MAP: 1) if AstraNova requests contracting-level changes to data residency or subprocessor clauses, that will push order-form finalization 10–14 days; 2) any additional SOC attestation requests beyond the standard report will require a security review cycle and may affect the 7/30 SOC window.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min sync Monday 6/22 10:00am ET to confirm owners and open questions,
2) Redwood delivers MSA redline v1 and DPA annotated responses by 6/25,
3) Joint checkpoint 7/08 to confirm SOC artifacts and order form timing.

I've attached Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (contains milestone rows, owners, and dependency flags). Let me know if you prefer a different cadence.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lindsey Parker <lindsey.parker@astranova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Cole <evan.cole@astranova.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form)

Thanks Grace — draft MAP looks good and the owner assignments make sense. A few follow-ups after a quick review:

- Legal timing: our internal legal has limited windows for redline review next week (6/28–7/01). If Redwood can get the MSA redline to us by 6/25 we should be able to route it through their queue.
- DPA: we'll circulate the annotated questions to our privacy team; their priority is an explicit subprocessor list or a commitment to share within the contract.
- SOC 2: we can accept a recent SOC 2 report + a Redwood data-flow diagram; can Karthik confirm the availability of a short artifact by 7/02?

One minor ask: can you call out a contingency in the MAP that triggers if the MSA redline deviates on indemnity or data residency? Procurement needs the contingency to evaluate internal approval risk.

We can take the 30-min sync on Monday 6/22 10am ET — Evan will send the invite.

Best,
Lindsey
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Parker <lindsey.parker@astranova.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + legal sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form)

Lindsey / Grace — quick note from legal on sequencing and known risk items: 

- We can produce an MSA redline (Redwood_MSA_redline_v1.docx) by 6/25 with our standard commercial terms. If AstraNova proposes a change to the indemnity cap or insists on data-residency carve-outs, we will flag those as escalation items that will require bilateral negotiation and a potential 7–10 day slip.
- For the DPA: we will provide section-level proposed edits and a subprocessor list by 6/22. If AstraNova needs contractual guarantees about subprocessor audits beyond our published controls, legal will need a 1-week review window to scope the request.
- SOC 2 deliverable: Karthik will produce a short data-flow diagram and a SOC 2 summary memo for your security team by 7/02. If your team needs a third-party attestation transfer or live evidence, that will add time to the 7/30 target.

Contingency language suggestion for the MAP: add a binary gating row that says — "If MSA redline includes non-standard indemnity/data residency requests, trigger executive approval and extend order-form finalization by up to 14 days."

I'll send the redline to you and Grace when complete.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
